user.title: MSI Mystic Light bridge
user.description: Address of the Windows PC running the Mystic Light bridge, and the token from its config.json.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge, or the Mystic Light SDK is not ready (is the bridge running elevated and MSI Center installed?).
error.no_leds: The bridge is running but reported no LEDs.

init.title: Power cap
init.description: Limits total LED output as a share of full white. Bright white can draw more than an ARGB header supplies, which makes fans flicker; saturated colours are unaffected until they exceed the cap.
